native_scan.exit_code_meaning: Report generation succeeded. No severity threshold was supplied; this is not a passing image gate.
native_scan.counting_scope: Scanner package/advisory matches, not unique vulnerabilities or demonstrated exploits. Raw public-image report retained privately.

triage.finding: Six upstream manifests identify VS Code extensions named handlebars/npm/grunt/ini/json/diff. Image-byte confirmation remains required before any exclusion.
Bundled Node 22.21.1 and node_modules predate advisory fixes. Reachability and permission-model preconditions were not established.
Modules are embedded in containerd/ctr/rootlesskit/Buildx binaries. Advisory reachability is unverified.
Dockerfile pins Python 3.13.15. Its tarfile source precedes the linked hardlink-target backport; no blanket backport dismissal is justified.

remediation_decision.reason: The pinned Dockerfile retains Python 3.13.15 and downloads OpenVSCode v1.109.5 with its own bundled Node. Updating global Node/npm does not update that bundled runtime.
remediation_decision.narrower_capability_image: INSTALL_CAPABILITIES=browser can omit vscode and nested Docker through native upstream controls, but retains the Python issue and requires separate feature-set acceptance.
remediation_decision.next_gate: Maintained replacement image/source inputs, native rescan and independent runtime/lifecycle/quality acceptance. No image promotion from this scan.

delegation.trigger: Consequential image acceptance decision and conflicting maintained-release versus fixable High/Critical evidence.
delegation.result: No supported full-image remediation accepted; source-backed triage retained.
